title: LA Colossal – Son Mai 02 (Standing)
prompt:
Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Black woman in her late 20s, long knotless box braids with small gold cuffs, natural face with a bright smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly hanging in multiple deep overlapping rolls down toward the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips far wider than the shoulders, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body Vietnamese son mai lacquer body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface, not latex. Deep glossy black lacquer with gold-leaf bamboo and areca palms, silver-leaf koi, and crackled white eggshell water ripples. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Pose: Standing in a three-quarter front view, one hand lifting her braids at shoulder height, the other hand resting on her outer hip, torso turned open toward the camera. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Very high 8-inch black lacquer platform stiletto sandals with spiral straps coiling up the calf like a vine, gold-leaf accents.
Nails: Extra long coffin nails, gold leaf over black.

Background & Lighting: MANDATORY seamless matte black studio background. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm gold key with raking side light and soft rim light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
